description: Backcode guidelines outside Backcode: in repos connected to a project that turns them on, remind Claude to put every feature or fix in its own worktree and PR, and (when required) ask before a direct commit or push to the main branch. The runner decides; without it, nothing happens.

hooks.command: B="$(command -v backcode 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.backcode/bin/backcode")"; [ -x "$B" ] && "$B" hook session-start 2>/dev/null; exit 0
B="$(command -v backcode 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.backcode/bin/backcode")"; [ -x "$B" ] && "$B" hook pre-tool-use 2>/dev/null; exit 0
